items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met Douglas Fairbanks, Jr., even, and was intrigued by the fact that he wore a necktie for a belt.

ctx.x: They‟d do broadcasts that were concerts, a variety show. They‟d have a few singers in the band. I did that as long as the show lasted, probably less than a year. I got to meet a lot of people, because I was writing charts for all the guest artists that he had, as well as for the band. So I met all these stars. I never worked for them. At least I can say
that I met them. I met Douglas Fairbanks, Jr., even, and was intrigued by the fact that he wore a necktie for a belt.
